messages:
alice: Quick heads-up — opened a tiny PR to add an SDK snippet for streaming responses. Need a reviewer and a docs-preview check before merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/428
ben: assigning carla? she knows the SDK examples best these days. :+1:
carla: I can take a look in ~30m. Any merge window constraints?
alice: Thanks! We prefer merging doc fixes during the midday merge window to avoid blocking nightly runs. Hoping to merge before tomorrow 10:00 PT.
emma: FYI the docs preview flakey job failed on the last PR — might be flaky for new snippet layout. docs-bot created a preview though: https://preview.docs.redwood.dev/pr-428
docs-bot: docs-preview started for PR #428 — build 3124. Linkcheck: running.
carla: saw the preview. Linkcheck is failing on one internal link: `/api/streaming/` -> 404 in the preview site. Guessing new routing changed.
alice: ah yes — the streaming section got moved under `/guides/streaming`. The snippet references the old path.
ben: easy fix — replace `/api/streaming/` with `/guides/streaming/` and re-run.
carla: will push the small change. Patch:```diff
- See /api/streaming/ for streaming usage
+ See /guides/streaming/ for streaming usage
```
alice: thanks. after you push, can someone re-run the docs-preview job?
emma: i can trigger it, but if linkcheck still flakes we should disable the strict linkcheck for internal anchors on previews (follow-up issue).
carla: updated and pushed. New commit 7f9a2b3.
docs-bot: re-running docs-preview for PR #428 — build 3125. Linkcheck: running.
emma: preview looks good now. linkcheck passed. visual diff small change to snippet only.
ben: great. carla — would you mind being listed as reviewer in the PR so we can track rotation counts? we try to credit reviewers for the monthly rotation.
carla: sure, added myself as reviewer.
alice: perfect. I'll merge during the midday window tomorrow if no objections. If anything else pops up, ping me here. :sparkles:
ben: thanks all. quick and smooth. :tada:
